full_judgment: Shahabuddin Ahmed, J. - The question for determination in this appeal by special leave is whether, in a case for pre-emption under Section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950, the pre-emptor, a contiguous land holder, is entitled to pre-emption of the whole of the land transferred consisting of seven plots out of which his land is contiguous to only two of such plats. Both the trial court and the lower appellate court answered the question in the affirmative, and the High Court Division in revision having concurred with that decision the pre-emptee has come in this appeal before us.
